text:
Nora (Sales): ACME wants to sign the POC today; they sent an orderform but redlined SLA to 99.99% and swapped Net30->Net45. Need quick legal+finance check.
Sam (Legal): Share redline. 99.99% ok only for Dedicated production; for POC propose 99.95% with credit bands. Also reinsert fallback routing clause.
Diego (Finance): Net45 ok for enterprise deals; for POC we require 50% prepay. We can accept Net45 on remaining balance after prepay. Need billing entity and tax id to issue PO.
Pri (Solutions): Technical: to reach 99.99% we'd need warm standby and multi-region which is costly for a short POC (2 x a100 equiv, 750k tokens/day). Recommend 99.95 for POC.
Nora (Sales): ACME asked for SOC2 and the completed security questionnaire attached to the order. I requested PO and billing name.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/0xacme291 (status: sent)
Sam (Legal): I'll post a short redline: Option A (POC): 99.95% + credit schedule; Option B (Prod/Dedicated): 99.99% with surcharge. Also: SLA applies only to endpoints listed in the orderform.
Diego (Finance): Preparing invoice template: 50% due on execution, remainder Net45. Billing code ACME-291.
Nora (Sales): Action items: Sam -> redline; Pri -> upload SOC2 + questionnaire; Diego -> invoice template. I'll chase ACME procurement for PO. :thumbsup:
